description: Uzay, astronomi ve teknolojiye ilgi duyan bir öğrenciyim. NASA Space Apps Challenge kapsamında uzay görevleri ve yenilikçi teknolojiler üzerine kendi projemi geliştirmek istiyorum. Projemde araştırma, görev tasarımı, yapay zekâ ve uzay teknolojileri konularına odaklanıyorum.

details: Project Name: HÜRRIYET / ORBIS (Controlled Laser-Assisted Orbital Debris Removal Concept) What it does & How it works: HÜRRIYET is a conceptual small spacecraft designed to address the growing orbital debris problem. Equipped with a front-facing camera, optical sensors, AI-assisted analysis, a hybrid solar-RPS power system, and a nose-mounted laser, the spacecraft detects, tracks, and analyzes inactive debris. Instead of physical capture or intentional explosion, it investigates non-contact momentum transfer via controlled laser ablation to gradually modify the target's orbit. Benefits & Impact: By utilizing non-contact momentum transfer, ORBIS aims to mitigate collision risks in Earth orbit while minimizing the creation of dangerous new fragmentation debris, thereby enhancing long-term space safety. Tools & Technologies Used: * Conceptual spacecraft architecture combining optical tracking, AI-assisted target analysis, and a hybrid solar-RPS power system. * Mathematical modeling and simulation-based orbital analysis pathways. * AI tools were utilized for brainstorming, English-language editing, presentation preparation, and conceptual visual generation. Creativity & Design Factors: The project combines an airplane-inspired spacecraft configuration with controlled laser ablation and a hybrid power architecture, offering a systematic, research-backed, and testable approach to orbital debris mitigation rather than conventional destructive methods.
